description: High-protein, energy-dense nutrient ratios rich in DHA for cognitive development and balanced calcium/phosphorus for sturdy bone growth.
dailyCalorieGuide: Approx. 55-65 kcal per lb of body weight
keyNutrients: DHA & EPA for retinal and neurological development

description: Balanced macronutrients tailored to body size, daily exercise, and lean muscle preservation.

description: Moisture-rich, low-carbohydrate nutrition providing essential amino acids (Taurine, Arginine) that cats cannot synthesize internally.
frequency: Kittens: 3-4 meals | Adults: 2-3 small wet/dry combo meals
dailyCalorieGuide: Approx. 20-30 kcal per lb of lean body weight
keyNutrients: Essential Taurine for cardiac and ocular health
High moisture content (75%+) through wet food to prevent urinary FLUTD issues
Omega-6 & Omega-3 fatty acids for skin and coat luster
proTips: Cats have a low thirst drive. Incorporating wet canned food daily protects kidneys and urinary tract health.
